import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { constants } from 'node:fs';
import { lstat, open, realpath } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { isAbsolute, relative, resolve, sep } from 'node:path';
import { StringDecoder } from 'node:string_decoder';
import { pythonWorkerEnv } from '../tools/python-env.js';
export class ParserError extends Error {
    code;
    retryable;
    constructor(code, message, retryable = false) {
        super(message);
        this.code = code;
        this.retryable = retryable;
        this.name = 'ParserError';
    }
}
function fail(code, message) { throw new ParserError(code, message); }
const hash = (data) => createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
const object = (value) => typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
const json = (value, depth = 0) => {
    if (depth > 64)
        return false;
    if (value === null || typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'boolean')
        return true;
    if (typeof value === 'number')
        return Number.isFinite(value);
    if (Array.isArray(value))
        return value.every(item => json(item, depth + 1));
    return object(value) && Object.values(value).every(item => json(item, depth + 1));
};
const jsonObject = (value) => object(value) && json(value);
const integer = (value) => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;
const digest = (value) => typeof value === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value);
function positive(value, fallback) {
    const result = value ?? fallback;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(result) || result < 1)
        fail('parser_options_invalid', 'Parser limits and timeout must be positive integers');
    return result;
}
function checkAbort(signal) {
    if (signal?.aborted)
        fail('parser_cancelled', 'Document parsing was cancelled');
}
function protocolError() { return fail('parser_protocol_invalid', 'Parser returned an invalid protocol message'); }
function validateMessage(value, request) {
    if (!object(value) || value.protocol !== 1 || value.id !== request.id)
        protocolError();
    if (value.type === 'progress') {
        if (typeof value.stage !== 'string' || typeof value.progress !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value.progress) || value.progress < 0 || value.progress > 1)
            protocolError();
    }
    else if (value.type === 'error') {
        const error = value.error;
        if (!object(error) || typeof error.code !== 'string' || !/^[a-z0-9_]{1,100}$/.test(error.code) || typeof error.message !== 'string' || typeof error.retryable !== 'boolean')
            protocolError();
    }
    else if (value.type === 'result') {
        if (value.operation !== request.operation || !jsonObject(value.result))
            protocolError();
    }
    else
        protocolError();
    return value;
}
// Keep the owned process/group identity alive until every private worker pipe
// reaches EOF. Descendants never inherit Node's public stdout/stderr handles.
// Windows uses a kernel Job Object, so a worker exit cannot orphan its children
// or require a delayed taskkill against a potentially reused worker PID.
const supervisorSource = String.raw `
import os, subprocess, sys, threading

def windows_job():
    import ctypes
    from ctypes import wintypes
    class Basic(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [
            ('process_time', ctypes.c_longlong), ('job_time', ctypes.c_longlong),
            ('flags', wintypes.DWORD), ('minimum', ctypes.c_size_t),
            ('maximum', ctypes.c_size_t), ('active', wintypes.DWORD),
            ('affinity', ctypes.c_size_t), ('priority', wintypes.DWORD),
            ('scheduling', wintypes.DWORD),
        ]
    class Extended(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [
            ('basic', Basic), ('io', ctypes.c_ulonglong * 6),
            ('process_memory', ctypes.c_size_t), ('job_memory', ctypes.c_size_t),
            ('peak_process', ctypes.c_size_t), ('peak_job', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ]
    kernel = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
    kernel.CreateJobObjectW.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, wintypes.LPCWSTR]
    kernel.CreateJobObjectW.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
    kernel.SetInformationJobObject.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, wintypes.DWORD]
    kernel.SetInformationJobObject.restype = wintypes.BOOL
    kernel.GetCurrentProcess.argtypes = []
    kernel.GetCurrentProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
    kernel.AssignProcessToJobObject.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.HANDLE]
    kernel.AssignProcessToJobObject.restype = wintypes.BOOL
    job = kernel.CreateJobObjectW(None, None)  # unnamed, non-inheritable handle
    info = Extended()
    info.basic.flags = 0x2000  # JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE; no breakaway
    if not job or not kernel.SetInformationJobObject(job, 9, ctypes.byref(info), ctypes.sizeof(info)):
        raise OSError('job initialization failed')
    if not kernel.AssignProcessToJobObject(job, kernel.GetCurrentProcess()):
        raise OSError('job assignment failed')
    return job  # OS closes this handle when the supervisor terminates

try:
    job = windows_job() if os.name == 'nt' else None
    worker = subprocess.Popen(
        [sys.executable, '-B', '-u', sys.argv[1]],
        stdin=sys.stdin.buffer, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        close_fds=True,
    )
except Exception:
    sys.stderr.write('Parser process isolation could not initialize\n')
    sys.exit(125)

def relay(source, destination):
    try:
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(source.fileno(), 65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            destination.write(chunk)
            destination.flush()
    except (BrokenPipeError, OSError):
        pass
    finally:
        source.close()

threads = [
    threading.Thread(target=relay, args=(worker.stdout, sys.stdout.buffer)),
    threading.Thread(target=relay, args=(worker.stderr, sys.stderr.buffer)),
]
for thread in threads:
    thread.start()
code = worker.wait()
for thread in threads:
    thread.join()
sys.exit(code if code >= 0 else 128 - code)
`;
/** Framework-independent bridge; every call owns a separate worker process. */
export class DocumentParser {
    options;
    timeoutMs;
    maxInputBytes;
    maxOutputBytes;
    maxArtifactBytes;
    maxRequestBytes;
    constructor(options) {
        this.options = options;
        if (!isAbsolute(options.pythonExecutable) || !isAbsolute(options.workerPath))
            fail('parser_options_invalid', 'Python executable and worker must use absolute paths');
        this.timeoutMs = positive(options.timeoutMs, 60_000);
        this.maxInputBytes = positive(options.maxInputBytes, 64 * 1024 * 1024);
        this.maxOutputBytes = positive(options.maxOutputBytes, 16 * 1024 * 1024);
        this.maxArtifactBytes = positive(options.maxArtifactBytes, 128 * 1024 * 1024);
        this.maxRequestBytes = positive(options.maxRequestBytes, 64 * 1024);
    }
    async capabilities(call = {}) {
        const message = await this.invoke({ protocol: 1, id: randomUUID(), operation: 'capabilities' }, call);
        if (message.type !== 'result' || message.operation !== 'capabilities')
            protocolError();
        return message.result;
    }
    async parse(input, call = {}) {
        checkAbort(call.signal);
        const request = { ...input, protocol: 1, id: randomUUID(), operation: 'parse', limits: {
                ...input.limits,
                max_input_bytes: Math.min(input.limits?.max_input_bytes ?? this.maxInputBytes, this.maxInputBytes),
                max_artifact_bytes: Math.min(input.limits?.max_artifact_bytes ?? this.maxArtifactBytes, this.maxArtifactBytes),
            } };
        await this.validateInput(input.input, request.limits.max_input_bytes);
        if (!isAbsolute(input.artifact_dir))
            fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Artifact directory must be absolute');
        const root = await realpath(input.artifact_dir).catch(() => fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Artifact directory is unavailable'));
        if (root !== resolve(input.artifact_dir) || !(await lstat(root)).isDirectory())
            fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Artifact directory must be a regular directory without symlinks');
        checkAbort(call.signal);
        const message = await this.invoke(request, call);
        if (message.type !== 'result' || message.operation !== 'parse')
            protocolError();
        await this.validateDocument(message.result, request, root, call.signal);
        return message.result;
    }
    async validateInput(input, max) {
        if (!input || typeof input.name !== 'string' || !input.name || /[/\\]/.test(input.name) || input.name.length > 255 || typeof input.path !== 'string' || !isAbsolute(input.path) || !digest(input.sha256) || !integer(input.size_bytes))
            fail('parser_input_invalid', 'Input identity and absolute path are required');
        if (input.size_bytes > max)
            fail('input_limit_exceeded', 'Input exceeds the byte limit');
        if (await realpath(input.path).catch(() => '') !== resolve(input.path))
            fail('parser_input_invalid', 'Input must be a regular file without symlinks');
        const data = await this.readBounded(input.path, max, 'parser_input_invalid');
        if (data.length !== input.size_bytes)
            fail('input_size_mismatch', 'Input size does not match request');
        if (hash(data) !== input.sha256)
            fail('input_hash_mismatch', 'Input hash does not match request');
    }
    async readBounded(path, max, code) {
        const file = await open(path, constants.O_RDONLY | (constants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0)).catch(() => fail(code, 'Parser file is unavailable'));
        try {
            const stat = await file.stat();
            if (!stat.isFile() || stat.size > max)
                fail(code, 'Parser file exceeds limits or is not a regular file');
            const chunks = [];
            let total = 0;
            while (true) {
                const buffer = Buffer.alloc(Math.min(64 * 1024, max - total + 1));
                const { bytesRead } = await file.read(buffer, 0, buffer.length, null);
                if (!bytesRead)
                    break;
                total += bytesRead;
                if (total > max)
                    fail(code, 'Parser file exceeds the byte limit');
                chunks.push(buffer.subarray(0, bytesRead));
            }
            return Buffer.concat(chunks, total);
        }
        finally {
            await file.close();
        }
    }
    invoke(request, call) {
        checkAbort(call.signal);
        const timeout = positive(call.timeoutMs, this.timeoutMs);
        const serialized = JSON.stringify(request) + '\n';
        if (Buffer.byteLength(serialized) > this.maxRequestBytes)
            fail('parser_request_limit', 'Parser request exceeds the byte limit');
        return new Promise((resolveResult, reject) => {
            const env = pythonWorkerEnv(this.options.pythonExecutable);
            const child = spawn(this.options.pythonExecutable, ['-B', '-u', '-c', supervisorSource, this.options.workerPath], { stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'], shell: false, windowsHide: true, detached: process.platform !== 'win32', env });
            const decoder = new StringDecoder('utf8');
            let pending = '';
            let outputBytes = 0;
            let settled = false;
            let terminal;
            let terminationReason;
            const settle = (reason, message) => {
                if (settled)
                    return;
                settled = true;
                clearTimeout(timer);
                call.signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
                child.stdin.destroy();
                child.stdout.destroy();
                child.stderr.destroy();
                child.unref();
                if (reason)
                    reject(reason);
                else if (message)
                    resolveResult(message);
            };
            const terminate = (reason) => {
                if (settled || terminationReason)
                    return;
                terminationReason = reason;
                clearTimeout(timer);
                call.signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
                // Only this invocation's recorded process/group is terminated, never names or ports.
                // The supervisor is still alive if any descendant retains a worker pipe;
                // never send a later signal after observing its exit (PID reuse risk).
                if (child.pid && child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) {
                    if (process.platform === 'win32') {
                        child.kill('SIGKILL'); // closing its Job Object also kills descendants
                    }
                    else {
                        try {
                            process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL');
                        }
                        catch {
                            child.kill('SIGKILL');
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Close parent-owned pipe handles immediately, then await the recorded
                // supervisor's close event. Inherited private worker pipes cannot delay
                // this event after cleanup; application shutdown can rely on rejection
                // meaning that its supervised process has been reaped.
                child.stdin.destroy();
                child.stdout.destroy();
                child.stderr.destroy();
            };
            const abort = () => terminate(new ParserError('parser_cancelled', 'Document parsing was cancelled'));
            const timer = setTimeout(() => terminate(new ParserError('parser_timeout', 'Document parsing timed out', true)), timeout);
            call.signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
            if (call.signal?.aborted)
                abort();
            const consume = (line) => {
                if (settled || terminationReason)
                    return;
                try {
                    if (!line || terminal)
                        protocolError();
                    const message = validateMessage(JSON.parse(line), request);
                    if (message.type === 'progress')
                        call.onProgress?.(message);
                    else
                        terminal = message;
                }
                catch {
                    terminate(new ParserError('parser_protocol_invalid', 'Parser returned an invalid protocol message'));
                }
            };
            child.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => {
                outputBytes += chunk.length;
                if (outputBytes > this.maxOutputBytes) {
                    terminate(new ParserError('parser_output_limit', 'Parser output exceeds the byte limit'));
                    return;
                }
                pending += decoder.write(chunk);
                let newline;
                while ((newline = pending.indexOf('\n')) !== -1) {
                    const line = pending.slice(0, newline);
                    pending = pending.slice(newline + 1);
                    consume(line);
                }
            });
            // Count and drain stderr; do not surface native errors containing paths/content/credentials.
            child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => {
                outputBytes += chunk.length;
                if (outputBytes > this.maxOutputBytes)
                    terminate(new ParserError('parser_output_limit', 'Parser output exceeds the byte limit'));
            });
            child.stdin.on('error', () => { });
            child.on('error', () => terminate(new ParserError('parser_start_failed', 'Document parser could not start', true)));
            child.on('close', (code, signal) => {
                if (settled)
                    return;
                if (terminationReason) {
                    settle(terminationReason);
                    return;
                }
                pending += decoder.end();
                if (pending.length)
                    consume(pending);
                if (settled)
                    return;
                if (terminationReason) {
                    settle(terminationReason);
                    return;
                }
                if (code === 125) {
                    settle(new ParserError('parser_start_failed', 'Parser process isolation could not initialize', true));
                    return;
                }
                if (code !== 0 || signal) {
                    settle(new ParserError('parser_crashed', 'Document parser exited unexpectedly', true));
                    return;
                }
                if (!terminal) {
                    settle(new ParserError('parser_protocol_invalid', 'Parser returned no result'));
                    return;
                }
                if (terminal.type === 'error') {
                    settle(new ParserError(terminal.error.code, terminal.error.message, terminal.error.retryable));
                    return;
                }
                settle(undefined, terminal);
            });
            child.stdin.end(serialized);
        });
    }
    async validateDocument(value, request, root, signal) {
        if (!object(value) || !object(value.document) || !Array.isArray(value.blocks) || !Array.isArray(value.warnings) || !jsonObject(value.diagnostics))
            protocolError();
        const document = value.document;
        if (document.name !== request.input?.name || document.input_sha256 !== request.input?.sha256 || typeof document.parser_version !== 'string' || !document.parser_version || document.canonicalization_version !== 'blocks-double-newline-v1' || document.offset_unit !== 'unicode_code_point' || typeof document.canonical_text !== 'string' || document.canonical_sha256 !== hash(document.canonical_text))
            protocolError();
        const chars = Array.from(document.canonical_text);
        const texts = [];
        let offset = 0;
        let index = -1;
        let bytes = 0;
        let images = 0;
        const ids = new Set();
        const paths = new Set();
        for (const b of value.blocks) {
            checkAbort(signal);
            if (!object(b) || typeof b.id !== 'string' || !b.id || ids.has(b.id) || !integer(b.block_index) || b.block_index <= index || !jsonObject(b.provenance) || !jsonObject(b.metadata))
                protocolError();
            ids.add(b.id);
            index = b.block_index;
            if (b.kind === 'text') {
                if (typeof b.text !== 'string' || !b.text || typeof b.block_type !== 'string' || !object(b.canonical_range) || !integer(b.canonical_range.start) || !integer(b.canonical_range.end))
                    protocolError();
                if (texts.length)
                    offset += 2;
                const length = Array.from(b.text).length;
                if (b.canonical_range.start !== offset || b.canonical_range.end !== offset + length || chars.slice(offset, offset + length).join('') !== b.text)
                    protocolError();
                offset += length;
                texts.push(b.text);
            }
            else if (b.kind === 'image') {
                images++;
                if (request.limits?.max_images && images > request.limits.max_images)
                    fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Image count exceeds the limit');
                if (typeof b.artifact_path !== 'string' || !b.artifact_path || isAbsolute(b.artifact_path) || /[\\:\0]/.test(b.artifact_path) || b.artifact_path.split('/').some(part => !part || part === '.' || part === '..') || paths.has(b.artifact_path) || !digest(b.sha256) || typeof b.mime_type !== 'string' || typeof b.original_mime_type !== 'string' || !b.original_mime_type.startsWith('image/') || !integer(b.width) || b.width < 1 || !integer(b.height) || b.height < 1)
                    fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Parser returned invalid image metadata');
                paths.add(b.artifact_path);
                const path = resolve(root, b.artifact_path);
                const local = relative(root, path);
                if (local.startsWith('..' + sep) || isAbsolute(local))
                    fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Image artifact escapes its job directory');
                let current = root;
                for (const part of b.artifact_path.split('/')) {
                    current = resolve(current, part);
                    const info = await lstat(current).catch(() => fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Image artifact is unavailable'));
                    if (info.isSymbolicLink())
                        fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Image artifacts cannot use symlinks');
                }
                if (await realpath(path) !== path)
                    fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Image artifact escapes its job directory');
                const data = await this.readBounded(path, (request.limits?.max_artifact_bytes ?? this.maxArtifactBytes) - bytes, 'parser_artifact_invalid');
                bytes += data.length;
                if (hash(data) !== b.sha256 || !this.matchesImage(data, b.mime_type))
                    fail('parser_artifact_invalid', 'Image artifact hash or MIME does not match its bytes');
            }
            else
                protocolError();
        }
        if (texts.join('\n\n') !== document.canonical_text)
            protocolError();
        for (const w of value.warnings) {
            if (!object(w) || typeof w.code !== 'string' || typeof w.message !== 'string' || (w.block_index !== undefined && !integer(w.block_index)))
                protocolError();
        }
        checkAbort(signal);
    }
    matchesImage(data, mime) {
        if (mime === 'image/png')
            return data.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]));
        if (mime === 'image/jpeg')
            return data[0] === 255 && data[1] === 216 && data[2] === 255;
        if (mime === 'image/gif')
            return /GIF8[79]a/.test(data.subarray(0, 6).toString('ascii'));
        if (mime === 'image/bmp')
            return data.subarray(0, 2).toString('ascii') === 'BM';
        if (mime === 'image/tiff')
            return data.subarray(0, 4).equals(Buffer.from([73, 73, 42, 0])) || data.subarray(0, 4).equals(Buffer.from([77, 77, 0, 42]));
        if (mime === 'image/webp')
            return data.subarray(0, 4).toString('ascii') === 'RIFF' && data.subarray(8, 12).toString('ascii') === 'WEBP';
        return false;
    }
}
